notes.title: Moonlight Pulse is a metroidvania set inside an immense interstellar organism now with a Linux version
notes.notes:
Set inside an immense interstellar organism, Moonlight Pulse looks like a fun metroidvania and recently it gained a Native Linux version.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/moonlight-pulse-is-a-metroidvania-set-inside-an-immense-interstellar-organism-now-with-a-linux-version/

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Updated Unity to 6000.0.43f1
+ Removed Unity logo from the splash screen.
+ Added Linux build.
+ Fixed a bug where the game would be stuck in slow-motion when restarting during a particular boss fight.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Release Notes
notes.notes: + Fixed a glitch where a game over wouldn't trigger under particular conditions while fighting the final boss.

notes.title: Moonlight Pulse is now available in Simplified Chinese and Japanese!
notes.notes:
With this major update, Moonlight Pulse can now be experienced in multiple languages.  Our friends at °Know Team have localized the game's text into Simplified Chinese and Japanese, allowing more players across the globe to enjoy the game to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316806/e5767b8302f1481148b4af83a917e2ace1d0efdc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316806/c549010ff2b759d2971827eb7757c4cb59503a1d.png[/img]

For returning players, the game's displayed language should adjust automatically based on the PC's locale settings.  The language can also be changed manually via a new setting in the options menu.

This announcement coincides with a discount for the Steam Autumn Sale, in which the game will be 35% off for the next week.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed enemy falling through a vessel offscreen in a mid game area.
+ Fixed invincibility exploit with the Never-Melting Bar.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed softlock that would occur when playing with instructions disabled.
+ Prevented Charlotte from grabbing a ledge that doesn't exist.
+ Fixed a hole in a wall in an early area.
+ Fixed an error logged by the MapTilesImage shader.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed issue with Silex appearing twice in a cutscene when particular conditions are met.
+ Fixed additional typo.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed additional typos.
+ Prevented an obscure situation where Silex could exit the map boundary near the first boss.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ The player's temp directory is no longer used when saving.

This should fix the "105" error some players were getting while saving the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Added instructions indicating that Charlotte can grab ledges.
+ Fixed typo in late game dialogue.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed issue when using Silex's secondary ability near Aorasque's neck.
+ Added instructions for dashing through vessels.

notes.title: (Demo) Version 0.3.7 Release Notes
notes.notes: + Prevented error window from popping up when playing the game for the first time.

notes.title: (Demo) Version 0.3.6 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Removed link to feedback survey.
+ Fixed collider in early Silex dash level.
+ Fixed error that sometimes occurred when opening items menu with less players.

notes.title: (Demo) Version 0.3.5 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Changed sorting order of platforms in the esophagus.
+ Added delay to prevet player from accidentally reentering vessels.
+ Made Pipen fight a tad tougher.
+ DualSense (PS5 controller) icons now display properly.
+ Added drop shadow to boss health bar text.
+ Added temporary invisible wall after beating Pipen.
+ Very slightly decreased vertical reach of Silex's air dash.

notes.title: (Demo) Version 0.3.4 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed soft lock when getting above the Shell Plaza earlier than intended.
+ Added hint for reaching the second boss.
+ Added 'looming presence' theme to a particular encounter.

notes.title: (Demo) Version 0.3.3 Release Notes
notes.notes:
+ Fixed forced aspect ratio functionality.
+ Fixed issue where camera could be out of bounds on some screen resolutions.
+ Metadata added to .exe file.
